title: Application caches
whyItMatters: Application caches can retain thumbnails, previews and temporary copies of documents long after the original was closed.
source: Apple macOS User Guide, the Library folder; per-user caches live in ~/Library/Caches
notes: Sizes and counts only; no cached file is opened. Caches under /Library and container-specific caches elsewhere are not covered.

steps: Quit every app, because a running app writes its cache again when it closes.
Delete the folder named in the plan, then restart the Mac.
Check that the apps you use still start normally afterwards.
cleanup.risk: Apps rebuild caches on next launch, so first starts are slower and offline copies held in caches are lost.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Delete files and folders on Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/delete-files-and-folders-on-mac-mchlp1093/mac
